data.title: Elsawady
data.short_description: EL-Sawady ERP is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for managing farms and agribusiness operations, unifying production, inventory, sales, procurement, finance, HR, and e-commerce in a single dashboard.
data.description:
EL-Sawady is a full-stack ERP solution, tailored for agriculture and livestock operations in the MENA region. It serves farms, agribusiness companies, livestock and poultry operations, and distribution companies that need operational and financial control from a single system.

The platform runs as a SaaS model with multi-tenant data isolation, customizable subscription plans, and role-based access control (RBAC). It supports Arabic and English with RTL UI, and exposes a REST API for mobile apps and external e-commerce frontends.
data.challenge:
Most farms and agribusinesses rely on fragmented tools Excel, paper records, and messaging apps which leads to:

Scattered data with no unified operational view
No accurate livestock tracking for vaccinations, breeding, and milk production
Unmonitored inventory that runs out without warning
Disconnected procurement, sales, and accounting —> making real profitability hard to measure
Manual HR management —> errors in attendance, leave, and payroll
Standalone e-commerce not linked to actual stock levels
Difficulty scaling to new branches or SaaS customers without a centralized platform
data.solution:
EL-Sawady delivers a unified ERP platform that connects the full business cycle from production to invoicing:

Central dashboard for all modules via web
Per-customer data isolation (Multi-Tenant) with subscription and plan management
Smart alerts for vaccinations, low stock, employee document expiry, and expected deliveries
Operational–financial linkage pen, crop, and poultry costs flow into profit & loss reports
Fine-grained permissions each user sees and manages only what they need
Plan-based module activation (Feature Gating) for flexible pricing and sales
Ready REST API for mobile apps and e-commerce integration

related_projects.title: Multi-Vendor Salon & Beauty Booking Platform
related_projects.short_description: A multi-vendor beauty platform connecting salons, independent professionals, and customers. Users can discover services and products, book appointments, shop online, and use offers, while administrators manage operations, orders, and payments.
related_projects.description: A complete marketplace for salon and beauty services. Customers can browse salons and independent professionals by city and category, review profiles and ratings, select a service or package and an available time slot, then book an appointment or place a product order. The platform includes management of salons, specialists, freelancers, services, packages, products, stock, offers, and orders. The admin dashboard covers bookings, sales statistics, users, content, commissions, payments, inquiries, and complaints. The project includes a customer web interface, an admin dashboard, and an API for customer and provider apps.
related_projects.challenge: Managing multiple salons, independent professionals, and their products in one system while coordinating availability, tracking bookings and orders, and giving customers a clear experience across locations and providers.
related_projects.solution: A unified platform that connects service and product discovery with booking, shopping, payment, and order tracking. It provides a customer experience, provider tools for services and orders, and a central dashboard for content, operations, and reporting.

related_projects.title: SportHub — Sports Club & Fitness Center Management System
related_projects.short_description: An integrated management system for sports clubs and fitness centers, combining member, subscription, and payment management with facial recognition device integration to simplify daily operations, manage access, and track attendance.
related_projects.description:
We developed a digital platform that brings the administrative and operational workflows of sports clubs and fitness centers into a centralized dashboard supporting Arabic and English. The platform manages members, trainers, and facility sections, alongside subscription plans, pricing, durations, freezes, reactivation, and extensions. It also supports payment, transaction, and invoice tracking.

The platform integrates with facial recognition devices to connect access permissions with subscription status and record entry events. It provides traffic indicators based on access logs and includes APIs for member services such as registration, browsing plans and subscriptions, uploading bank transfer receipts, and receiving notifications.
related_projects.challenge: Sports clubs and fitness centers face operational challenges when member records, subscriptions, and payments are spread across manual records and disconnected systems. Managing entry devices separately from subscription data adds verification work for staff and makes expired or frozen memberships harder to monitor. Without consolidated attendance data, managers also have limited visibility into peak hours and activity across facility sections.
related_projects.solution: A centralized platform that connects member records, subscriptions, and payments with entry devices. The system updates access permissions according to subscription status, records attendance, and brings financial transaction reviews into one dashboard. Traffic indicators, notifications, and digital member services help reduce manual follow-up, simplify club operations, and improve the member experience.

related_projects.title: Nusk Al-Umrah
related_projects.short_description: An integrated digital platform for managing and booking Umrah and Hajj packages, including a web portal, admin dashboard, and mobile app connecting customers, agents, and management in one unified system.
related_projects.description: Nusk Al-Umrah is a comprehensive platform for religious tourism companies, enabling the creation of Umrah and Hajj packages composed of hotels, apartments, ground and air transport, meals, and additional services. It delivers a seamless booking experience for customers via the website or mobile app, alongside a powerful admin dashboard covering bookings, users, agents, and financial reporting.
related_projects.challenge: Umrah and Hajj travel agencies often rely on fragmented, manual operations: phone or spreadsheet-based bookings, disconnected hotel and transport inventory, difficulty tracking agent commissions, and no unified digital customer experience. This leads to operational errors, slower service, and challenges in scaling and data management.
related_projects.solution: A unified multi-channel platform that centralizes all booking and management operations: customers browse and book packages via web or mobile, agents manage their bookings and commissions through a dedicated portal, and administrators control inventory, packages, bookings, and users from a central dashboard with real-time statistics and automated PDF invoicing.
